release_notes: Build 67 adds a dedicated Website Ads tab in app Settings, with a clear Configure AdSense action for turning website ads on or off and entering AdSense details.
Website Ads now accepts either a ca-pub publisher ID or a pasted AdSense ad-unit code snippet and extracts the publisher ID and first ad-slot automatically.
The Factburst Quiz featured/full-quiz panel is compact again instead of expanding into a large empty area.
Moving to the next quiz question now preserves the current page position instead of jumping back to the top.
Google AdSense remains disabled by default and only uses wide-screen side-rail placements when explicitly enabled.
